replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: I don’t usually get anxious about math, but I do feel stressed when problems require quick calculations under pressure. My low neuroticism score means I handle stress better than others, so I stay calm even during tough math tasks.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I used AI tools like ChatGPT to check my solutions for algebra problems. replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: First, write the equation in standard form ax² + bx + c = 0. Then, use the quadratic formula: x = [-b ± √(b² - 4ac)] / (2a). Plug in the coefficients, calculate the discriminant, and solve for x. This method works for all quadratic equations.

To find stationary points, take the first derivative f'(x), set it equal to zero, and solve for x. Then, plug those x-values back into f(x) to get the y-coordinates. Check if they’re maxima or minima using the second derivative test.
